reviews.title: Perfect for PS5 internal SSD!
reviews.comment: I installed this in my PS5 for some extra space to install games into and it's working exactly as expected. Install was surprisingly easy, just two notes if you do this: 1. The plastic cover for the PS5 is tricky to get off. You pull the top part out while pushing the panel down. Many guides weren't helpful here but you don't have to push too hard, just out and down. 2. There is a little screw and cylindrical metal standoff inside the PS5 expansion spot already that can be used to mount the card correctly. I didn't see any guides reference this but you move the little standoff to the corresponding spot where the card half hole is at the end just underneath the card and then it's supported nicely. I can now install so many games on my system and it's actually completely changed how I think about downloading and keeping games, it's such a relief to not care anymore about file sizes! And playing even current gen titles with big open worlds seems to work fine from it, no notable difference installed in the console storage or this.
reviews.author: Tyler and Amber

reviews.title: Fast efficient products
reviews.comment: So I recently got another MOVE SPEED product I wanted for a while, at a great price thanks to prime and it's discounts. It's fast feels well made and reliable. (1T portable SSD) Loved it. So I decided to go with this nmve m.2 SSD 2T to upgrade my PS4 pro with a fast external bank so far so good product arrived fast unharmed (untested) Edit* I have since tested this product it's great and fast. I found the heat sink it was in the packaging. I'm using an INEO USB 3.1 M. 2 SSD Enclosure for it. It's a fanned Heatsink. Combined they work fast and stays cool even with graphics heavy games and loads. And you can use the provided graphene sticker and heat sink with it
